fields.title: Whole-hull leakage and dry gas
fields.finding: Inherited seam/node/port leaks and dry-species permeability are assumptions. Dry ingress limits nominal ultrabarrier intervals.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure full pressure-rise/species curves and actual leak rates; resolve all pressure-normalised permeability units.

claim: Inherited seam/node/port leaks and dry-species permeability are assumptions. Dry ingress limits nominal ultrabarrier intervals. | Whole-hull leakage and dry gas
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
